instruction: Automatically stabilize shaky video footage using motion detection algorithms.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VLC does not have automatic video stabilization capabilities. While VLC has some video filters, automatic motion-based stabilization requires complex algorithms not available in VLC.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - VLC does not have automatic video stabilization capabilities with motion detection algorithms
